---
title: "GOV.UK brand.yml"
---

An unofficial [`_brand.yml`](https://github.com/cjrace/govuk-brand-yml) that
themes Bootstrap, bslib and Quarto sites with GOV.UK Design System colours.
This page is themed by that same file - what you're looking at *is* the
demo.

Here's a [link to the repo](https://github.com/cjrace/govuk-brand-yml) -
tab to it, or to any button below, to see GOV.UK's black-and-yellow focus
state.

## Typography

<p class="h1">Heading style 1</p>
<p class="h2">Heading style 2</p>
<p class="h3">Heading style 3</p>
<p class="h4">Heading style 4</p>

Body text uses the plain `Arial, sans-serif` fallback stack (see the
README for why GDS Transport isn't included), with headings set at weight
700. Here's a sentence with `inline code` in it.

## Code

A short [shinyGovstyle](https://github.com/dfe-analytical-services/shinyGovstyle)
example, to show how code blocks and inline code (like `button_Input()`)
are styled:

```r
ui <- shiny::fluidPage(
  shinyGovstyle::header(
    org_name = "Example",
    service_name = "User Examples",
    logo = "shinyGovstyle/images/moj_logo.png"
  ),
  shinyGovstyle::gov_layout(
    size = "two-thirds",
    shinyGovstyle::button_Input(
      inputId = "btn1",
      label = "Continue",
      type = "default"
    )
  ),
  shinyGovstyle::footer(full = TRUE)
)
```

## Colour palette

### Semantic colours

These six map directly onto Bootstrap's `primary` / `secondary` / `success`
/ `danger` / `warning` / `info` slots via `_brand.yml`'s `color:` section.

<div class="row row-cols-2 row-cols-md-3 g-3 mb-4">
<div class="col"><div class="bg-primary" style="height: 70px;"></div><small>primary &larr; brand-colour</small></div>
<div class="col"><div class="bg-secondary" style="height: 70px;"></div><small>secondary &larr; secondary-text-colour</small></div>
<div class="col"><div class="bg-success" style="height: 70px;"></div><small>success &larr; success-colour</small></div>
<div class="col"><div class="bg-danger" style="height: 70px;"></div><small>danger &larr; error-colour</small></div>
<div class="col"><div class="bg-warning" style="height: 70px;"></div><small>warning &larr; focus-colour</small></div>
<div class="col"><div class="bg-info" style="height: 70px;"></div><small>info &larr; link-colour</small></div>
</div>

### Full palette

The rest of `_brand.yml`'s palette (text, border and surface tones) has no
Bootstrap semantic slot, so these swatches are hardcoded to the current hex
values for display.
